% pdflatex-tate-pairs.tex -- pair glue table-drive assertions (tate).
% For each (from,to) class pair: reads the natural glue the table emits
% (\jlreqpdf@emitpair) and compares with the value read back from the
% pair@<from>@<to> entry via the \jlreqpdf@fixedpair capture shim.
% Asserts pair emission is driven by the loaded tate JFM table (values
% read from the table itself; survives data replacement).
\documentclass[pdflatex,tate,paper=a5]{jlreq}
\pagestyle{empty}
\makeatletter
\def\jlreqdbgnat{}
\let\jlreqdbg@fixed@orig\jlreqpdf@fixedpair
\def\jlreqdbg@installshim{\def\jlreqpdf@fixedpair##1##2##3{\gdef\jlreqdbgnat{##1}}}
\def\jlreqdbg@restoreshim{\let\jlreqpdf@fixedpair\jlreqdbg@fixed@orig}
\jlreqdbg@installshim
\def\measurepair#1#2{% from,to
  \expandafter\ifx\csname jlreqpdf@jfm@pair@#1@#2\endcsname\relax
    \typeout{TATE-PAIR-SKIP: #1->#2 (undefined in table)}%
  \else
    {\csname jlreqpdf@jfm@pair@#1@#2\endcsname}% capture nat in zw
    \jlreqdbg@restoreshim
    \global\jlreqpdf@lastclass=#1\relax
    \global\jlreqpdf@curclass=#2\relax
    \global\jlreqpdf@inhibit=0\relax
    \global\jlreqpdf@kernmode=0\relax
    \setbox\@tempboxa=\hbox{\jlreqpdf@emitpair}%
    \@tempdima=\wd\@tempboxa
    \@tempdimb=\dimexpr\jlreqdbgnat\jlreq@zw\relax
    \@tempdimc=\dimexpr\@tempdima-\@tempdimb\relax
    \ifdim\@tempdimc<\z@ \@tempdimc=-\@tempdimc\fi
    \ifdim\@tempdimc<0.5pt\relax
      \typeout{TATE-PASS: PAIR #1->#2 (\the\@tempdima~ ==~ \the\@tempdimb)}%
    \else
      \typeout{TATE-FAIL: PAIR #1->#2 (\the\@tempdima~ !=~ \the\@tempdimb)}%
    \fi
    \jlreqdbg@installshim
  \fi}
\begin{document}
\measurepair{15}{6}
\measurepair{15}{7}
\measurepair{1}{15}
\measurepair{7}{15}
\measurepair{6}{15}
\measurepair{15}{15}
\end{document}
